metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: NASA/ORNL/DAYMET_V4 (daily 1 km precip, covers 1980-present; band = “prcp” in mm per day) - Location: Washington D.C. – a small Point at the city center is fine (lat 38.907, lon ‑77.037) - Time: 2018-01-01 → 2018-12-31 2. Masking strategy - DAYMET is gap-filled; no cloud mask needed. - Keep only 2018 images → already filtered by date. 3. Calculation & validation - Sum daily rainfall for the year (multiply by 0.0393701 to convert mm → inches). - Use ee.Reducer.sum() with a 1 km scale (native resolution). - Check collection size (should be 365). - If collection is empty → C1. - If reducer returns null/None → C3. - If sum ≥ 50 inches → A, else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time dc = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.037, 38.907]) yr = '2018' start, end = f'{yr}-01-01', f'{yr}-12-31' # 2. Data acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/ORNL/DAYMET_V4') \ .select('prcp') \ .filterDate(start, end) n_img = col.size().getInfo() print(f"{yr} Images: {n_img}") if n_img == 0: print("C1") # 3. Annual total rainfall (mm → inches) annual = col.sum().multiply(0.0393701) # mm to inches tot = annual.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=dc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('prcp').getInfo() # 4. Check result if tot is None: print("C3") else: print(f"Total rainfall: {tot:.1f} in") print("A" if tot >= 50 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
dc = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.037, 38.907])
yr = '2018'
start, end = f'{yr}-01-01', f'{yr}-12-31'

# 2. Data acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/ORNL/DAYMET_V4') \
        .select('prcp') \
        .filterDate(start, end)

n_img = col.size().getInfo()
print(f"{yr} Images: {n_img}")
if n_img == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Annual total rainfall (mm → inches)
annual = col.sum().multiply(0.0393701)      # mm to inches
tot = annual.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=dc,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('prcp').getInfo()

# 4. Check result
if tot is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Total rainfall: {tot:.1f} in")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if tot >= 50 else "<answer>B</answer>")
